title: Mirage
definition: A naturally occurring optical phenomenon in which light rays are bent via refraction to produce a displaced or distorted image of distant objects or the sky, caused by varying refractive indices in layers of air of different temperatures.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (GS-1 Science & Tech / Physics) via direct or applied questions on atmospheric refraction, total internal reflection, and optical illusions.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Mirage.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
